subject: Finishes that connect living spaces
hook: Gold or black handles? It's the cheapest way to tie two rooms together.
ig:
Gold or black handles? It's the cheapest way to tie two rooms together.

When the kitchen and living room share a space, using the same handle on both is one of the easiest ways to connect them. But the two options behave differently.

A: Antique gold
Warm, decorative, and lifts oak-effect and darker colours. It draws the eye, so it works best when it's repeated with intent, not scattered.

B: Matt black
Graphic and understated. It almost disappears on charcoal or black woodgrain and gives a sharp contrast on matt white, but it adds less warmth.

Both come with soft-close doors and drawers as standard on our furniture, so this is purely a looks decision.

Which would you pick, and what colour are your fronts? Comment A or B with your door colour.
fb:
Little decision, big difference: antique gold or matt black handles?

Gold brings warmth and works beautifully with oak-effect and deeper colours, but it's a statement. Matt black is quieter on dark fronts and crisp on white. Use the same one across your kitchen and living-room furniture and the rooms instantly feel linked.

Which way would you go? Tell us your door colour and your pick.
